entries.receive: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
entries.release: Name one thing that can remain unfinished until morning.
entries.rest: God of peace, hold what I cannot finish, and let me receive this night as a gift. Amen.

entries.receive: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
entries.release: Set down the burden you were never meant to carry alone.
entries.rest: Jesus, meet me in my weariness and teach my heart to rest in you. Amen.

entries.receive: Be still, and know that I am God.
entries.release: Let one unanswered question be quiet for tonight.
entries.rest: God, quiet the noise in me and keep watch while I am still. Amen.

entries.receive: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
entries.release: Put one worry into words, then entrust it to God.
entries.rest: Father, receive what troubles me and remind me that I am held in your care. Amen.

entries.receive: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you.
entries.release: Release the need to replay one difficult moment.
entries.rest: Christ, let your peace be stronger than the day still echoing in me. Amen.

entries.receive: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
entries.release: Notice where your body is asking you to stop striving.
entries.rest: Good Shepherd, lead me out of hurry and into the rest you provide. Amen.

entries.receive: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
entries.release: Leave tomorrow's trouble on tomorrow's side of the night.
entries.rest: Lord, be my shelter tonight and steady my trust for the morning. Amen.
